caseName: City of Parma v. Record Revolution No. 6, Inc.
caseNameFull: City of Parma, Ohio v. Record Revolution No. 6, Inc.

opinions.text:
Appeal from C. A. 6th Cir. Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of the recently enacted Section 2925.14 of the Ohio Revised Code.

Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
